LanguageData.CC_Heart_Band_Steady_Desc: Holding up. Nothing extra to carry.
LanguageData.CC_Heart_Band_Strained_Desc: Hard days are adding up: -3 mood, and dreams turn darker.
LanguageData.CC_Heart_Band_Worn_Desc: Tired to the bone: -5 mood, works 5% slower, and nightmares come more often.
LanguageData.CC_Heart_Band_Breaking_Desc: Close to the end of their rope: -8 mood, works 10% slower, nightmares are common, and from 85 they may need a day to themselves.
LanguageData.CC_Heart_Help_Healing: rest in a good hospital bed
LanguageData.CC_Heart_Help_Grieve: time to grieve: a funeral, a grave, friends nearby
LanguageData.CC_Heart_Help_Recreation: free time and something fun to do
LanguageData.CC_Heart_Help_Light: light where they work and sleep
LanguageData.CC_Heart_Help_Prepare: getting ready for what's coming: food, medicine, defenses
LanguageData.CC_Heart_Help_Friends: a long talk with a friend
LanguageData.CC_Heart_Help_Sleep: quiet nights in a warm bed
LanguageData.CC_Heart_Help_Party: a party, a concert or a feast
LanguageData.CC_Heart_Need_Belonging_Desc: Friends here, a partner, family, good moments with others, and not being left out.
LanguageData.CC_Heart_Need_Purpose_Desc: Doing work they love, a life goal, a seat on the council, learning something new.
LanguageData.CC_Heart_Need_Safety_Desc: No danger at the door, food and medicine in store, decent defenses, and their own health.
LanguageData.CC_Heart_Need_Freedom_Desc: Time outdoors and time of their own, varied work, getting out into the world, and few restrictions.
LanguageData.CC_Heart_NeedsAllMet: All four are well met, so strain drains 20% faster.
LanguageData.CC_Heart_NeedsExplain: The heart's needs give no mood of their own. The one a colonist lacks most makes the wishes and life goals that answer it up to 35% likelier, and when all four are 60 or more, strain drains 20% faster.
LanguageData.CC_Heart_Why_PassionOff: work they love is turned off
LanguageData.CC_Heart_Cause_Newcomer: a new face in the colony
LanguageData.CC_Heart_F_Grief_Desc: Sorrow for someone dead or gone: a friend, family, a partner, a bonded animal. It fades as the memories do, and a funeral, a grave or a friend nearby helps it along.
LanguageData.CC_Heart_F_Grief_Does: Adds up to 3 strain a day while it lasts, and runs deeper when they're worn down. Makes a wish for a proper grave likelier, moments of shared grief more common and dreams of the dead more frequent. Psychopaths don't feel it.
LanguageData.CC_Heart_F_Fear_Desc: Danger here and now: enemies on the map, lying downed, pain, a fresh wound, things in the dark.
LanguageData.CC_Heart_F_Fear_Does: Adds up to 3 strain a day while it lasts, and runs deeper when they're worn down. Makes wishes for defenses, armor and weapons likelier and nightmares more common. The nervous feel it more; the iron-willed and the bloodthirsty, less.
LanguageData.CC_Heart_F_Dread_Desc: Worry about what's coming rather than what's here: a fight the colony knows is on its way, a warband in the region, a debt, a lean winter, too little medicine.
LanguageData.CC_Heart_F_Dread_Does: Adds up to 2 strain a day and slows recovery by up to 10%. Makes wishes for defenses, medicine, food stores and firewood likelier. Getting ready for what's coming eases it.
LanguageData.CC_Heart_F_Anger_Desc: Insults, slights, fights, council decisions that went against them, a grudge, a rival close by. Often it has one person's name on it.
LanguageData.CC_Heart_F_Anger_Does: Makes frictions with others up to 60% likelier, more still with the person it's about, and warm moments up to a quarter rarer. Makes wishes for justice likelier.
LanguageData.CC_Heart_F_Shame_Desc: Something they did or let happen: a prisoner executed or sold, a body butchered, someone banished, a break they'd rather forget, a secret out in the open.
LanguageData.CC_Heart_F_Shame_Does: They start up to 30% fewer warm moments with others. Makes wishes that make amends likelier: a grave, mercy for a prisoner, care for the hurt. Psychopaths don't feel it.
LanguageData.CC_Heart_F_Envy_Desc: Someone else has what they want: a better room, finer things, the council's favor, the seat they lost.
LanguageData.CC_Heart_F_Envy_Does: Makes frictions up to 35% likelier, more still with the person they envy, and wishes for the same things likelier: a nicer room, fine clothes, jewelry, better gear.
LanguageData.CC_Heart_F_Disgust_Desc: Raw or rotten food, corpses lying about, the smell of rot, human leather, insect meat, a filthy home.
LanguageData.CC_Heart_F_Disgust_Does: Makes frictions up to 20% likelier, and wishes for a clean colony, better food and a proper dining table likelier.
LanguageData.CC_Heart_F_Loneliness_Desc: Nobody here they'd call a friend, a partner far away, being left out.
LanguageData.CC_Heart_F_Loneliness_Does: Makes warm moments with others up to 50% likelier, and wishes for a party, music or an animal companion. Love eases it. Recluses don't feel it.
LanguageData.CC_Heart_F_Homesick_Desc: New here, or with family living somewhere else. It fades as they come to belong.
LanguageData.CC_Heart_F_Homesick_Does: Makes wishes for good food and small keepsakes likelier, and dreams of home and the absent more common.
LanguageData.CC_Heart_F_Frustration_Desc: Wishes refused or left to lapse, broken promises, a vote lost, work they love turned off, things that keep going wrong.
LanguageData.CC_Heart_F_Frustration_Does: Their wishes run out up to 15% sooner, and frictions are up to 30% likelier. Makes wishes to do the work they love likelier.
LanguageData.CC_Heart_F_Despair_Desc: Low spirits for days, losses close together, a colony that's losing, strain near breaking. The opposite of hope.
LanguageData.CC_Heart_F_Despair_Does: Adds up to 2 strain a day, slows recovery by up to 20% and makes a day off up to 25% likelier. Hope eases it.
LanguageData.CC_Heart_F_Joy_Desc: Good meals, parties, lovin', a wish granted, a victory, an inspiration.
LanguageData.CC_Heart_F_Joy_Does: Strain drains up to 25% faster. Makes warm moments and sweet dreams more common, and wishes for a party or music likelier.
LanguageData.CC_Heart_F_Pride_Desc: Good work, an impressive room, a victory, a seat on the council, a name the colony gave them, a title.
LanguageData.CC_Heart_F_Pride_Does: Strain drains up to 15% faster. Makes wishes for art, banners, fine things and a grander room likelier.
LanguageData.CC_Heart_F_Love_Desc: A partner or spouse close by, a new baby, family together.
LanguageData.CC_Heart_F_Love_Does: Strain drains up to 10% faster. Makes warm moments up to 35% likelier, most of all with the one they love, and sweet dreams more common. Eases loneliness.
LanguageData.CC_Heart_F_Gratitude_Desc: Someone rescued them, tended them, taught them or did them a kindness, or the council granted a wish or kept a promise.
LanguageData.CC_Heart_F_Gratitude_Does: Makes warm moments up to 30% likelier, more still with the person they're grateful to. When the council is among the reasons, their trust in it grows by a point every few days.
LanguageData.CC_Heart_F_Hope_Desc: Spring, a new face in the colony, a wound healing, strain lifting, a goal in reach, a fresh start.
LanguageData.CC_Heart_F_Hope_Does: Strain drains up to 20% faster, and despair fades. Makes wishes for books, lessons and things that grow likelier.
LanguageData.CC_Heart_F_Awe_Desc: An aurora, an eclipse, a comet, beautiful rooms and art, strange creatures, the unexplained.
LanguageData.CC_Heart_F_Awe_Does: Makes wishes for art, flowers, a fountain or a shrine likelier, and strange dreams more common. Very rarely it turns into an inspiration, once a month at most.
LanguageData.CC_Heart_F_Contentment_Desc: Quiet days: no danger, a decent room, enough food, rest and free time, a good mood. The calm baseline.
LanguageData.CC_Heart_F_Curiosity_Desc: Research, books, new land, visitors with stories, something unexplained.
LanguageData.CC_Heart_F_Curiosity_Does: Makes wishes for books, lessons, a hunt or a journey likelier, and strange dreams more common.
LanguageData.CC_Heart_F_Restless_Desc: The same work day after day, too little fun, cabin fever.
LanguageData.CC_Heart_F_Restless_Does: Makes wishes to get outside, travel, hunt or take a day off likelier, and frictions up to 10% likelier.
LanguageData.CC_Heart_NotYet: Their heart is looked at once an hour. Check back soon.
LanguageData.CC_Heart_StrainExplain: Strain is separate from mood. It builds slowly from fighting, pain, losses, bad nights, hunger and low spirits (about 25 a day at most) and drains with sleep, free time, celebrations and good talks. Its only effect on mood is the strain mood itself.
LanguageData.CC_Heart_ColonySummary: Average strain {0} ({1}); {2} strained, {3} worn down or worse.
LanguageData.CC_Heart_DecreeStrain: Builds about {0} strain a day in those who resent it.
LanguageData.CC_Decree_NeedsHeart: Needs feelings and strain switched on (Mod settings, People page).
LanguageData.CC_Heart_Episode_Text: {PAWN_nameDef} has been carrying too much for too long: {SOURCES}. Today it was enough. {PAWN_nameDef} put down {PAWN_possessive} tools, went to {PAWN_possessive} room and won't be working for the rest of the day.\n\nNobody is in danger. {PAWN_nameDef} will still eat and sleep, and will mostly stay out of everyone's way. It passes in six to twelve hours, and afterwards most of the strain will have lifted. If trouble comes, it ends early.
LanguageData.CC_Heart_Episode_Chronicle: {PAWN_nameDef} was worn out and took a day away from work.
LanguageData.CC_Heart_Episode_Journal: Couldn't face the work today. I went to my room and shut the door, and nobody came knocking.
LanguageData.CC_Heart_Episode_Interrupted: {PAWN_nameDef} came out of {PAWN_possessive} room to face the danger.
LanguageData.CC_Heart_Episode_Over: {PAWN_nameDef} spent the day in {PAWN_possessive} room and is ready to work again. The worst of the strain has lifted.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_Heart_Tip: A layer under mood that never changes how the game decides on mental breaks. Each colonist builds strain from fighting, pain, losses and bad nights and drains it with rest and good times; from 30 it costs 3 to 8 mood, from 55 also 5 to 10% of their work speed. They also have one or two feelings at a time (grief, fear, pride, joy and more) that nudge their wishes, dreams and how they get on with others, and four long-term needs that show what their life is missing. Turned off, all of it stops, and the strain mood and slowdown are gone.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_HeartEpisodes: A colonist at the end of their rope takes a day off
LanguageData.CC_Settings_HeartEpisodes_Tip: At strain 85 or more, a colonist may stop working for six to twelve hours and keep to their room. Never in danger, never with fewer than two others able to work, at most once in 2 days in the colony and once in 10 days for each colonist. Afterwards their strain drops by about 40. Turned off, strain still builds and drains, but nobody takes a day.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_HeartInspector: Strain and feelings in the inspector
LanguageData.CC_Settings_HeartInspector_Tip: One short line in a colonist's details, such as "Strain: worn down · restless, proud". Needs the deeper game hooks.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_StrainSpeed_Tip: 50% for a gentler game, 150% for a harder one. The daily limits scale with it; how fast strain drains stays the same.
